title: Cherry Wild Rice
description: This cherry wild rice recipe blends brown rice and wild rice with fresh cherries and glazed almonds for an appetizing side dish that will get rave reviews.

steps.text: Bring 2 cups water and wild rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, 30 to 45 minutes. Drain excess liquid, fluff rice with a fork, and cook uncovered, about 5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, bring remaining 1/2 water and brown rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, about 45 minutes.

Combine cherries, brown sugar, and almonds in a large nonstick skillet; cook and stir over medium heat until brown sugar melts and cherries and almonds are coated, about 6 minutes. Stir in brown rice, wild rice, celery, orange juice, red wine vinegar, and orange zest; cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, about 5 minutes.
